artifact.expected: Manuel Academy Adaptive Tutor Core v0.2
artifact.rule: No Tutor Core symbol, enum, payload, dependency, or compatibility claim may be reconstructed from a handoff summary.

wave1Runtime.compatibilityDecision: Use a versioned dependency-neutral plain-JSON sidecar. Direct imports remain unapproved until the actual Core manifest and exports are inspected.

matrix.wave1Side: No Tutor Core manifest occurs in the four verified ZIPs.
matrix.decision: Populate only from the actual artifact.

matrix.wave1Side: Session 1 opaque branded IDs are byte-preserving.
matrix.decision: Probe preservation, wrong-session rejection, and timestamp semantics.

matrix.wave1Side: Session 1 categorical MasteryOutcome; Session 2 also has provisional numeric/boolean representations.
matrix.decision: Never infer categorical mastery from score/correct/successful.
Preserve an opaque Core outcome reference and only an approved low-detail projection; no raw narrative.

matrix.wave1Side: Session 1 structured status/skill/basis/next-action; Session 2 provisional boolean.
matrix.decision: Do not collapse to or expand from a boolean.

matrix.wave1Side: Session 1 insufficient-evidence states and Session 2 inconclusive/null are not proven equivalent.
matrix.decision: Map only exhaustively after actual enum inspection.

matrix.wave1Side: Session 2 guesses correct|reteach and provisional reteaching outcomes.
matrix.decision: Retire guessed canonicalization and avoid conflating a directive with an orchestrator phase.

matrix.wave1Side: Session 1 exposes bounded intervention evidence but no safety-command protocol.
matrix.decision: Core refusal/escalation/adult-review directives must veto pacing and UI.

matrix.wave1Side: Session 3 prototype board is hard-coded from SegmentDefinition.
matrix.decision: Add a validated command interpreter, unknown-command quarantine, and text-equivalent fallback.

matrix.wave1Side: Session 3 renders a current utterance/caption UI.
matrix.decision: Bind Core turns/captions to plain DTOs and require audio-unavailable fallback.

matrix.wave1Side: Session 3 accepts transcript ReactNode/text while Session 1 forbids raw transcript material in events.
matrix.decision: Study Engine stores reference-only projections; never ReactNode or transcript bodies.
Verify exact Core evidence basis and audience before mapping.

matrix.wave1Side: Session 4 assumes Core supplies purpose/priority but defines provisional enums.
matrix.decision: No integration inference; use verified Core enum or approved catalog.
Use StudyPlanId unless the actual Core exposes a more specific stable reference.
Core payloads must pass the same version gate; never reset/coerce.

matrix.wave1Side: Session 2 is ES2022/no-DOM and Session 3 is React/browser ESM.
matrix.decision: Keep the sidecar JSON-only until isolated Node and browser probes pass.

unsupportedAssumptions: Treating correct|reteach, successful|not_successful|inconclusive, numeric mastery, prerequisite booleans, or Session 4 review priorities as Core enums.
Mapping a Core outcome to confidence_check_completed.
Dropping misconception meaning without an opaque source outcome reference.
Passing raw answers, spoken turns, captions, transcripts, or adult-private bodies into Study Engine events or evidence.
Directly importing Core into both Node-only and browser bundles before exports and peer dependencies are known.
